name: 33912 · Fort Myers, FL
findings: ZIP 33912 (Fort Myers) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33912 (Fort Myers) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33912 (Fort Myers) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
